description: Transform your new tab into a serene sanctuary of Bhagavad Gita wisdom. Displays shlokas in Sanskrit, English, and Hindi, featuring text-to-speech reading, word meanings, and customizable themes.

cwsListing.shortDescription: Transform your new tab with Bhagavad Gita wisdom. Displays shlokas in Sanskrit, English, and Hindi with text-to-speech and meanings.
cwsListing.detailedDescription: Transform your new tab into a serene sanctuary of Bhagavad Gita wisdom. Displays shlokas in Sanskrit, English, and Hindi, featuring text-to-speech reading, word meanings, and customizable themes.
cwsListing.singlePurpose: Replaces the new tab page with a dashboard that shows Bhagavad Gita shlokas with translations, commentary and text-to-speech reading.

permissionJustifications.storage: Stores the user's theme, preferred language, text-to-speech voice settings, bookmarked verses, reading-streak stats and cached machine translations locally in chrome.storage.local so they persist across new tabs and sessions.

cwsListing.remoteCodeJustification: The extension does not use remote code. All JavaScript is packaged in the extension; it only loads Google Fonts stylesheets and fetches JSON translation data from the Google Translate endpoint, neither of which is executed as code.
